# kion_aws_account (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about Kion Aws Accounts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_aws_account" "example" {
  # Optional
  # id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the Aws Account.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the Aws Account.
